results.title: Sabiote - Wikipedia
results.body: Sabiote is a Spanish town and municipality situated in the northeastern part of La Loma, in the province of Jaén, autonomous community of Andalusia. It borders the municipalities of Úbeda, Torreperogil, Santisteban del Puerto and Navas de San Juan.

results.title: Visit Sabiote (Jaén) - What to see, things to do, monuments, museums...
results.body: Without a doubt, Sabiote is a hub of artistic and heritage significance on a national level. It is part of the Andrés de Vandelvira Renaissance Route, along with Úbeda, Baeza, Canena, and Villacarrillo. A tourism project that aims to highlight the mainly Renaissance heritage of these places.
